scripts.postinstall: bash -c 'if test -L node_modules/@aisoldier/ui-kit; then target=$(readlink node_modules/@aisoldier/ui-kit); if ! test -d "$target"; then echo "fixing broken symlink: $target"; rm node_modules/@aisoldier/ui-kit; ln -s ../../ui-kit node_modules/@aisoldier/ui-kit; echo "symlink fixed"; fi; fi && echo "checking /vercel/path0/ui-kit:" && ls -la ../../ui-kit 2>&1 | head -30'
